high_level_description: This image captures a person taking a selfie on a busy urban street. The individual is wearing a black cap with the letters "AR" and a green logo, a white face mask, and glasses. They are dressed in a black T-shirt featuring a colorful, circular design in shades of blue, green, yellow, and black. The background shows a multi-lane road with vehicles, including a green bus and a yellow auto-rickshaw. There are trees lining the street, providing some shade, and buildings can be seen further back, indicating an urban setting.
